name: Question 6
problem: The equivalent radical expression for ${({(\frac{2}{u})}^{1/4})}^{7/3}$ is
worked_solution:
First, we apply the power rule and then we express the resulting fractional power as a radical: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{({(\frac{2}{u})}^{1/4})}^{7/3} & = \\ {(\frac{2}{u})}^{(1/4)(7/3)} & = \\ {(\frac{2}{u})}^{7/12} & = \\ \sqrt[12]{{(\frac{2}{u})}^{7}}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 6
?

The equivalent radical expression for ((2u)1/4)7/3 is

a
 (2u)7|||||12
b
 (2u)6|||||7
c
 (2u)28|||||3
d
 (2u)12|||||7
e
 (2u)3|||||28
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we apply the power rule and then we express the resulting fractional power as a radical:

((2u)1/4)7/3=(2u)(1/4)(7/3)=(2u)7/12=(2u)7|||||12
